result.note: Tested the direction of August 2026 retail inflation and the level of wholesale fuel-and-power inflation; the rate-rise outlook is speculative and was left out.

questions.prompt: Consider the following statements about inflation data released in September 2026 for the month of August 2026:
items: Retail inflation eased to 4.82% in August 2026.
Wholesale inflation in the fuel-and-power category exceeded 20%.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explain: Retail inflation rose to 4.82% in August 2026, so it did not ease. Wholesale fuel-and-power inflation hit 22.93%, which kept a Reserve Bank rate rise in play even as 7.8% growth provided a cushion.
questions.source: Retail inflation rose to 4.82% in August while wholesale fuel-and-power inflation hit 22.93%
